model: LOGICA Digital Energy-series actuator DN10-DN50 (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Purmo LOGICA Digital Energy-series actuators on TOV valves DN10-DN50, using BACnet MS/TP.
summary: LOGICA Digital is a digital valve actuator for Purmo TOV valves that talks Modbus RTU or BACnet MS/TP. Over BACnet it takes a 0-100 % flow command or runs its own thermal-power or return-temperature control, reads two sensor inputs (P1/P2) for delta-T and energy, and reports position, estimated flow, power, energy and fault flags. Valve type, max flow and the control mode are set through writable objects.
notes: Object names are the Swedish labels printed in the Swedish edition of the integration guide (APR 22); the names stored in the actuator may differ. Descriptions here are in English.
The guide marks AV 4, AV 5 and AV 28 as R/(W): AV 4/5 are writable only when no P1/P2 sensor source is assigned, AV 28 only when the DIP address is 63.
MSV objects are listed as MV. MV 8 has two state lists, one for DN10-32 and one for DN40-50 actuators.
Hardware version and RTC time are properties of the device object, and the serial number a property of AI 1; they are not separate objects.
AI 9 is printed across a page break: it counts hours until flushing starts (0-4320), then the minutes left of a running flush (0-600). Units for AI 2/AI 3 follow the selected sensor type.
Some state texts are machine-translated in the guide (e.g. 'Fr.o.m'/'T.o.m' for off/on, 'Sida 2' where P2 is meant); they are kept as printed.

source.title: LOGICA Digital, Energy-series, DN10-DN50 - Handbok för BACnet-integrering

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP address on the DIP switches (19 200 baud default), pick the valve with MV 8 and its max flow in AV 30, then choose the operating mode in MV 4. In the default mode the BMS writes AV 1 (0-100 % relative flow); for energy control it writes the power or return-temperature setpoint instead. Read actual flow, position, power and the fault BIs, and set MV 6 for what happens on bus loss.

minimum_points.name: Driftsätt
minimum_points.why: Control mode: external signal, power or return temp

minimum_points.name: Funktionsfel på ställdonet
minimum_points.why: Actuator fault or sensor limit exceeded

integration.enable: MV 4 Driftsätt selects the control source: 1 = external signal on AV 1 (default), 8 = thermal power (AV 19), 9 = return temperature (AV 20); 2/3 force fully open or closed.
integration.heartbeat: MV 6 Kommunikationsfel sets the action after 120 s without bus traffic: no change, close, open, or go to the emergency position in AV 8 (default 30 %).
integration.remote_sensors: Supply and return temperatures come from P1/P2 sensors or from the bus: MV 5 picks the source, and with bus values the BMS writes AV 4 (supply) and AV 5 (return).
setup: MS/TP address is set on the DIP switches; AV 28 can only be written when the DIP address is 63.
Default baud rate 19 200; change it with MV 7, then restart the bus with MV 1 = 6.
Select the valve type in MV 8 and set AV 30 to the max flow that matches the manual valve presetting.
Sensor types for P1/P2 are set in MV 2/MV 3 (e.g. 7 = Pt1000).
gotchas: AV 4/AV 5 are read-only once a P1/P2 sensor is assigned as the temperature source.
Limit settings AV 22-24 use 0 to switch the limit off.
Writing 0 to AV 34 resets the continuous energy counter.
Object names in this list are the Swedish guide's labels.
